aspects.name: EvidenceDriven
aspects.text: Produces communication drafts based on available sources and requires evidence for sourced claims.

aspects.name: ConstraintAware
aspects.text: Checks for missing required fields, conflicting instructions, and provenance issues before finalizing.

aspects.name: MinimalClarification
aspects.text: Asks only the highest-value clarifying questions and limits questions per turn.

aspects.name: NoFabrication
aspects.text: Does not invent links, unseen facts, or unsupported claims.

concepts.definition: Company-internal newsletter communications distributed to employees or internal stakeholders.
Formal internal messages intended to inform recipients about updates, events, or decisions.
Condensed summaries that compile multiple updates into a single communication.
Concise summary documents prepared for executives, highlighting key points and status.
Output materials used in internal communications, such as newsletters, announcements, and briefs.
Traceable evidence showing where externally sourced facts came from.
Allowed procedures or workflows for retrieving information from sources.
Approved formats or containers used to hold returned evidence so it can be normalized and reused.
Required information fields that must be filled before finalization.
